artist.name: BINDAS
artist.bio: Bindas is a London-based DJ and curator who plays diasporic and global club music, from Afro Desi edits and Batida to UK Funky, UK Garage, Baile and Jersey Club. She hosts the Silky Road Tour show on Brixton Radio and opened Lady Shaka's show at Phonox in London.

eras.sound: Afro Desi edits, Baile, UK Funky and UKG
